proposedCalculationContract.rawHistory: Never overwrite original roll/retained raw evidence, Lucky hits, Pawn observations or fixed maximum provenance.
proposedCalculationContract.layer: At Roda Kekacauan store source-once transformations/costs/restrictions; evaluate at final phase. Proposed base transforms operate after existing Gambler raw-derived base and before additive bonuses.
proposedCalculationContract.inversion: 9-x, without clamping. A derived base18 would become-9; this is a proposal consistent with signed/unbounded scores, awaiting approval of operation order.
proposedCalculationContract.numeric: Main-stat/mastery bonuses and costs calculated final-only; no immediate Enchant from a mastery change.
proposedCalculationContract.powers: Chaotic powers need canonical intrinsic Tier1..5 definitions. Themed grants happen immediately at this event, exclude owned, and use recipient one shared mastery (reuse settled ordinary base; late first power needs its normal gate; God all-power base9 preserved).
proposedCalculationContract.guards: Filter absent weapon/weakness targets and incompatible combinations before their child draw. Unknown adapter/configuration stays needs_configuration; no automatic substitute reward.
proposedCalculationContract.hooks: Only actual late numeric rolls can count Lucky/Resilient/Pawn under approved contracts. Swap/inversion/fixed replacement/bonus projection do not create sampled raw hits. Exact late reroll/Gambler combinations require review.
proposedCalculationContract.equalizer: Uniform allowed leaves on each separate actual wheel, after hard guards. No stat5%..25% bounds on Chaos effect wheels.
proposedCalculationContract.followups: Complete chosen source effect and required children/reactions, then saved return to Title. No generic unconditional boost spin.
proposedCalculationContract.divine: Use complete12 follow-up algorithms in content/divine-followup-design.json. Final-only source budgets, atomic receipts, no extra generic boost; original raw preserved. Second Chance compares resolved pre-bonus bases for Double/Nothing; ordinary difference is raw difference.

proposedChaoticPowerWheel.direction: Space/target/causality/body glitches with bounded fictional scope; use no deterministic new owner-stat wheel rules inferred from power name.

noneContract.behavior: One actual None result/reaction. Preserve every earlier stat/bonus/power/weapon/weakness. No new Chaos/Divine event or boost.

divineBalanceContract.low: At most one permanent main-stat point or one1-point single-use conditional stat buff.
divineBalanceContract.medium: One targeted main-stat point, one mastery step, or one receh weakness disabled.
divineBalanceContract.high: At most2 direct main-stat points/negative-point compensation, or one bounded canonical Divine power Tier1–3.
divineBalanceContract.capsAreSourceRewardBudgetsOnly: Do not cap character totals/other bonuses/passive rewards. Signed/unbounded final stats preserved; ordinary one-weapon mastery gain can unlock normal final Enchant.
divineBalanceContract.conditionalTraits: One-use conditional stat bonuses remain labeled traits; not three new power grants, not always-on final stat increases, not mastery draws.
divineBalanceContract.secondaryHooks: Keep existing actual late Lucky/Resilient/Pawn/Enchant contracts; budget does not suppress authorized source hooks.
divineBalanceContract.universalPool: Tier filter only on this Divine Gift invocation; no global theme power tier/weight/registry changes.
